title: The King's Letters of Seoul

mainMystery.truth: Pilot of the Seoul historical season: only Case 01 (The Secret of the King's Letters, 1446) is written; it has no season mystery.
mainMystery.culprit: No one: the mystery is a burnt note in the new letters and what it says.
mainMystery.motive: Bun-i, who could not write Chinese characters, wrote her first letter to warn of a hole in the book hall roof.

characters.name: King Sejong
characters.role: The King of Joseon, who made the new letters (a real person; his words here are made up)

characters.name: Taek
characters.role: The night guard at the inner gate

characters.name: Sora
characters.role: A palace maid who teaches the new letters

characters.name: Bun-i
characters.role: A water-carrier girl who writes her first letter

notes: Season 5, Seoul (2026-11-05: the Seoul pilot, s7_seoulpilot, made the season): Case 01 only (The Secret of the King's Letters, redesigned 2026-11-04); Cases 02-12 not written. In the game by hand (lib/data/season5/season5_content.dart), made with generate_season.dart --target sandbox --out lib/data/season5/s5_seoul: the game target takes a season whole, with its opening.
Pictures: the Seoul pilot's own, made by season_factory.dart run --pictures-only (assets.manifest.json); the writing room reuses copy_room.
